title: A part payment lowers the payer's balance the same way everywhere
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced today for $210.00, billed to customer B, unpaid.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, invoiced today for $95.50, that bills itself, unpaid.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 3, for customer A, invoiced today for $40.00, that bills itself, unpaid.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's Invoices tab.
  2. Tick work order 1's invoice.
  3. Click New Payment.
  4. Enter 100.00 as the payment amount.
  5. Click Make Payment.
  6. Open the A/R Aging report for today.
  7. Open customer A's Invoices tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Both of customer B's invoices are listed.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1's invoice is ticked.

Step 3:

  • The New Customer Payment window opens.

Step 4:

  • The amount shows 100.00.

Step 5:

  • The payment is recorded.
  • Work order 1's invoice shows Balance $110.00 ($210.00 − $100.00).
  • Customer B's balances add up to $205.50 ($110.00 + $95.50 for work order 2).

Step 6:

  • Customer B's row shows $205.50.
  • Customer A's row still shows $40.00.

Step 7:

  • Only work order 3's invoice is listed, Balance $40.00: the payment did not touch customer A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • S10-R1: “The invoice's receivable posts to the Bill To's account, on its Invoices tab, AR Aging and statements.”
  • S10-R4: “A payment settles only invoices owed by the paying customer; one payment can cover several of its invoices across customers.”
  • Key Decisions: “A payment settles only invoices its own customer owes. Enforced for new payments only; existing applications are left as they are.”
